uncertainty.scope: Paired whole-chain bootstrap conditional on fixed checkpoints, block selection and arms. WP renormalizes each resample; fixed-energy/linear intervals resample ORIGINAL per-chain contributions, retaining original observed full-control W, means and SDs. They are not fully renormalized bootstrap deficits. Marginal 95% intervals, not simultaneous familywise intervals.

definitions.primary: Two planned reset-minus-full pooled clipped WP contrasts over all scored rows of all four blocks; not average block/sequence correlation.
definitions.fixed_error: Global reference normalizers are estimated on full-engine control over the same four-block scored population. Intervention fixed-energy change is NOT exactly minus its renormalized WP change.
definitions.folds: Fold WP renormalizes within that fold; fixed-energy/linear fold entries remain contributions using pooled-two-fold reference normalizers and total W.
definitions.linear: Half the target sum of E_w[(u-rho*z_full)*(clip(p_reset)-clip(p_full))/sd_p_full], a first-order approximation in postclip space; not an extra correction.
definitions.focus: class3 quiet>=64; class2 quiet/fresh and class3 fresh contrasts are descriptive localization, not selection gates.
definitions.inference: GRU-state ablation with fixed full-prefix features. A benefit would not by itself establish a deployable reset or a training gain.
